title: Saxophonie
identity: Serge Lancen’s Saxophonie is catalogued by Billaudot as MRB1044 B for alto saxophone in E-flat and piano. The Philharmonie de Paris guide lists a four-minute duration and gives movement tempo and range descriptions, but those details describe the guide’s catalog entry, not an inspected score.

evidence.claim: Billaudot product record confirms title, scoring, and catalog number.

The 1993 Philharmonie de Paris guide entry for Saxophonie (printed p. 27) lists two movements, tempos, a B-low to C-high range, about four minutes, and third-year placement. This is secondary pedagogical description; notation was not inspected.
evidence.source_name: Philharmonie de Paris digitized guide, 10 ans avec le saxophone

review_focus: Use the guide’s reported contrast between a slow Andantino and faster Allegro as a question for score review; its written-range terminology remains unverified against the edition.
collection_flag: The 1993 Philharmonie guide places this entry in its third-year list. That local historical classification does not establish a SaxoBrain level.
gaps: No notation visually inspected; verify range, meter and articulation in the Billaudot edition.
